concept: Charts billing ingestion for linked orgs

claims.text: A different organization, including an unlinked organization, can supply billing data when its ID and authorized API keys are provided. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The mongodb/atlas-billing repository labels its Realm-based implementation deprecated and unmaintained because native Charts billing dashboards exist. Its multi-organization example manually adds organization credentials and calls; it is not documentation of native linked-invoice ingestion internals. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

For cross-organization billing, configure ingestion with the paying organization ID and enable linked invoices; the configuration also selects a target deployment and database. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
Enabling linked invoices on an existing ingestion backfills three months per linked organization; a new ingestion backfills twelve months. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
Charts ingests invoices through the Invoices API and refreshes daily after the initial historical load. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Changes to invoices incurred within the last three months appear after the next scheduled ingestion. The documented update window does not promise correction of older invoices. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
A replacement ingestion requires a new database or deletion of the old database before reusing its name. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Dashboard creation requires Project Data Access Read/Write; the setup documentation specifies organization API keys with Organization Billing Admin and Organization Billing Viewer access. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The vendor engineering article recommends filtering linked-organization billing data by organizationId; it also describes tag-based allocation and ingesting an unrelated organization with its authorized API keys. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-03-06)

Charts supports customizable billing dashboards for analyzing organizational spending. The architecture guide describes prebuilt spending views and tag-based customization; an independent Manning chapter preview confirms the general billing-dashboard use case. (medium confidence)

Release notes record linked-organization ingestion support in v1.44.0 and v1.45.0, a payload-size ingestion fix in v1.45.0, and an older-invoice missing-line-item fix in v1.47.0. These are historical fixes, not evidence of current failures. (low confidence)
Charts uses the Invoices API to load twelve months initially and ingests billing data daily thereafter. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The release blog recommends filtering consolidated linked-organization billing data by organizationId; tags can support team and environment allocation views. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-03-06)

Release notes record linked-organization support in v1.44.0 (April 30, 2024), linked invoices during setup in v1.45.0 (July 4, 2024), and a payload-size ingestion fix in v1.45.0. These entries describe historical behavior and fixes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-07-04)

Manning describes Charts as supporting customizable billing dashboards for tracking database expenses, but the readable chapter preview does not document linked-organization ingestion. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)
